display_long_description:
Chimp is an intense VR horror experience that combines fast, physical gorilla-style locomotion with relentless survival terror. Using your own arms to swing, climb, and launch yourself through dark and claustrophobic environments, every movement feels real—and every mistake can be fatal.

You are trapped in a twisted world where something is always watching. As you navigate abandoned facilities, forests, and underground spaces, terrifying monsters roam freely, reacting to sound, movement, and fear. There are no weapons to rely on—only your instincts, your speed, and your ability to move.

The unique locomotion system forces you to stay constantly engaged. Your arms are your legs. Panic makes you sloppy. Fatigue makes you slow. And when the monsters are close, even a single missed grab can mean the end. Whether you’re climbing walls to escape, swinging across gaps, or desperately scrambling through the darkness, Chimp keeps you physically and mentally on edge.

Built from the ground up for VR, Chimp focuses on immersion, tension, and unpredictability. Dynamic audio, limited visibility, and aggressive AI ensure no two encounters feel the same. The game rewards quick thinking, smooth movement, and calm under pressure—but fear will always try to take control.

This is not a game you play sitting still.
This is not a game you play relaxed.

Chimp is a VR horror game where movement is survival—and the monsters are never far behind.
